title: FORGIVENESS ISN’T SAYING THEY WERE RIGHT — IT’S SAYING GOD IS BIGGER. 💫
paragraphs:
FORGIVENESS ISN’T SAYING THEY WERE RIGHT — IT’S SAYING GOD IS BIGGER. 💫
Sometimes forgiveness feels impossible. But when you forgive, you’re not excusing the pain — you’re declaring that God’s healing is greater than their hurt. 🌤️
Letting go isn’t weakness… it’s worship.
Because when you release what broke you, heaven has room to restore you. ✝️
✨ “Forgiveness isn’t about making them right — it’s about letting God make you whole.” ✨

“Be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, as God in Christ forgave you.”
— Ephesians 4:32 (ESV)
